# 7497 - Synchronous 6-bit binary rate multiplier

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7497.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7497.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 23 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7497 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7497.png) | ![7497 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7497.png) | ![7497 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7497.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 4 | A | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^0 |
| 1 | B | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^1 |
| 14 | C | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^2 |
| 15 | D | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^3 |
| 2 | E | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^4 |
| 3 | F | input |  |  | rate input, weight 2^5 |
| 9 | CLOCK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 13 | CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 11 | ENABLE INPUT | enable | low |  | controls pins 7; when not enabled: hold; Low lets the counter count; high holds the counter. Also gates the enable output. |
| 10 | STROBE | enable | low |  | controls pins 5, 6; when not enabled: high; Low enables the rate decoding gates; high inhibits them, so Z stays high (and Y then follows only the unity/cascade input). |
| 12 | UNITY/CASCADE | input |  |  | Second input of the Y gate. Low forces Y high. |
| 5 | Z | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | ENABLE OUTPUT | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Z = NOT( (CLOCK' AND STROBE') AND ( (F AND QA') OR (E AND QA AND QB') OR (D AND QA AND QB AND QC') OR (C AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD') OR (B AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD AND QE') OR (A AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD AND QE AND QF') ) ) | Z is a NOR of six rate gates. Each rate gate is open while CLOCK and STROBE are both low and the 6-bit counter is in the state that belongs to that rate bit; rate input F gives 32 pulses per 64 clocks, E 16, D 8, C 4, B 2, A 1. So with the counter enabled Z gives M low pulses per 64 clock pulses, M = 32F + 16E + 8D + 4C + 2B + A, f_out = M * f_in / 64. With all rate inputs low Z stays high. Gate inputs read from the functional block diagram (see unknown). |
| 6 | Y = NOT(Z AND UNITY/CASCADE) | Y is the complement of Z while UNITY/CASCADE is high (M high pulses per 64 clocks); a low UNITY/CASCADE forces Y high. Tying UNITY/CASCADE to CLOCK with STROBE high passes the clock inverted to Y. |
| 7 | ENABLE OUTPUT = NOT(ENABLE INPUT' AND QA AND QB AND QC AND QD AND QE AND QF) | Goes low once per 64 clocks, when the counter is enabled and reaches all ones (state 63); used as the enable/strobe of the next stage when cascading. Function table gives 1 pulse per 64 clocks. The block diagram (book page 7-103, read at 600 dpi on 2026-11-23) shows exactly seven inputs to this gate: the enable line and QA..QF. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 6

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR high: counter QA..QF = 0 at once (function table: Y low, Z high, enable output high; note B says the levels of clock and strobe can change Y and Z, and a low unity/cascade keeps Y high)
- CLEAR low, ENABLE INPUT low: the 6-bit synchronous binary counter (QA least significant) counts up by one on each rising clock edge, 64 states
- ENABLE INPUT high: the counter holds
- STROBE high: rate gates inhibited, Z high

## Not known

- Exact gate inputs of the six rate gates were read from the scanned functional block diagram (book page 7-103); the line-by-line wiring is not printed as text.

## Notes

Pin names follow the datasheet pin-out: B 1, E 2, F 3, A 4, Z 5, Y 6, ENABLE OUTPUT 7, GND 8, CLOCK 9, STROBE 10, ENABLE INPUT 11, UNITY/CASCADE 12, CLEAR 13, C 14, D 15, VCC 16. The recommended-conditions table column header for the 74 part reads 'SN7494' in the book; it is the SN7497 column (misprint in the source).
